gaps.title: Calibrated abstention to eliminate confident LLM hallucination
gaps.description: Large language models answer confidently even when they lack the knowledge. No method lets a model reliably recognize the boundary of its own knowledge and abstain, calibrated to its actual likelihood of being correct, without an external verifier.
gaps.canonical_description: calibrated self-knowledge for LLM abstention without external tools

gaps.title: Provably faithful chain-of-thought reasoning
gaps.description: No method guarantees that an LLM's stated reasoning steps causally determine its final answer (faithfulness) with a formal proof rather than empirical correlation. Current work only measures unfaithfulness post-hoc.
gaps.canonical_description: formally provable causal faithfulness of LLM chain-of-thought

gaps.title: Cheap data augmentation for low-resource NER
gaps.description: No systematic study compares simple back-translation versus synonym-replacement data augmentation for named-entity recognition in low-resource languages, leaving practitioners without guidance on the cheapest effective method.
gaps.canonical_description: which cheap data augmentation helps low-resource NER most

gaps.title: Robustness of image classifiers to adversarial perturbations
gaps.description: No training method reliably hardens image classifiers against adversarial perturbations without large clean-accuracy loss or across different threat models.
gaps.canonical_description: reliable adversarial robustness without accuracy loss or across threat models

gaps.title: Sequence transduction without recurrence
gaps.description: No competitive sequence transduction architecture dispenses with recurrence and convolution while modeling long-range dependencies.

g_abstention.reasoning: Recent work measures LLM calibration and proposes selective-answering heuristics, but none achieves calibrated abstention tied to true knowledge boundaries without an external verifier. The gap is open.

g_faithful_cot.reasoning: Several papers empirically measure chain-of-thought unfaithfulness, but none provides a formal guarantee that reasoning steps causally determine the answer. The gap remains open and appears very hard.

g_aug_ner.reasoning: No paper systematically benchmarks back-translation versus synonym-replacement augmentation for low-resource NER under matched conditions. The comparison is open.

g_adv_robust.reasoning: Adversarial training and certified defenses make meaningful progress, but each trades clean accuracy or covers only specific threat models. Substantial progress exists; the full gap is partially solved.

g_transformer_solved.reasoning: The Transformer architecture dispenses with recurrence and convolution entirely while modeling long-range dependencies via self-attention, and is the dominant competitive approach. The gap is solved.
